data.title: This Chinese Tech Giant Quietly Cut Its Buyback 80% to Fund AI
data.description: Alibaba is sitting on billions in buyback authorization yet chose to stop using it, redirecting cash into a bet that makes the next few quarters look very different from the last few years.
